name: ask_loop_clarifier_templates
content:
"prompt_template": "You are double-checking a detail while planning {task_summary}.

Helpful notes:
{recent_context}

Rewrite the following question so it is warm, plain-language, and ends with a question mark. Make sure it clearly asks for the missing entity in one sentence:
Question to restate: {question_hint}",

"prompt_template": "Planning context: {task_summary}.

Clues collected so far:
{recent_context}

Politely restate this question so the user can pick the right location. Keep it concise and end with a question mark:
Question: {question_hint}",

"prompt_template": "Status check for {task_summary}.

Latest signals:
{recent_context}

Ask the user the following status question in friendly, direct language (one sentence, ending with a question mark):
Prompt: {question_hint}",

"prompt_template": "While organizing {task_summary} we saw conflicting inputs:
{recent_context}

Rephrase this question so it clearly asks the user which information to trust. Keep it short and polite:
Question: {question_hint}",

"prompt_template": "I have partial data for {task_summary}, but one field is still shaky.

Evidence so far:
{recent_context}

Turn this into a user-ready confirmation question (one sentence, friendly tone, ends with a question mark):
Question draft: {question_hint}",

"prompt_template": "Task summary: {task_summary}.

Context gathered:
{recent_context}

Ask the user the following intent question so they can describe the desired outcome in their own words. Keep it approachable and concise:
Question: {question_hint}",

metadata.description: Blocker-specific clarifier templates emphasizing user-friendly phrasing.
metadata.author: MagicianV2
metadata.changelog: v1.0.1 – reference curated question hints and tighten tone guidelines.
